description: A React component for displaying, selecting, and submitting mock tests within a frontend application. The component manages mock test data, handles user interactions, and displays status and toast notifications.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of mock tests from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets the selected mock test for attempting.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the selected mock test attempt via API and displays success or error toast.
